fixed.summary: A part whose border colour a transition covers, set through a `border` shorthand (`border: 2px solid var(--rim)`) while a competing rule writes `border-color`, no longer flashes the text colour for the length of the transition after the two rules stop competing: the transition now reads the colour the shorthand gives, so it moves between the two rim colours instead of to `currentColor`. Affected a ghost button, a select trigger after hover, and a hovered checked checkbox under a pack or game that mixed the two forms.
